name: Triangulated Active Brick Boundary Mesh for Space Skipping
aliases: RTX-Accelerated Empty Space Skipping using Triangulated Active Region Boundary Geometry
definition: A space-skipping technique that replaces costly CUDA intersection tests with hardware-accelerated BVH traversal and triangle intersection. It constructs a boundary mesh of triangles representing the surface between active and inactive macrocells to determine ray entry/exit points.
summary: A GPU-accelerated space-skipping technique that replaces proxy boxes with a triangle mesh bounding active regions, solving transfer bottlenecks by generating geometry on the GPU for native RTX ray-triangle intersection.
